worldcombat.skill.synthesis.summary: After a short wind-up it commits to a sustained photosynthesis, splitting the missing health into 4 even sips: each sip reads the sunlight at that moment, so a brighter spot restores more per sip. It stands still throughout; an interrupt only cancels the remaining sips and keeps what already landed.
worldcombat.skill.synthesis.use.0: A large heal sipped under open sun
worldcombat.skill.synthesis.use.1: A small top-up in the shade
The whole photosynthesis restores %1$s of the missing health: higher with brighter sunlight (close to 2/3 at clear noon), only the minimum floor at night or under cover; higher Special Defence makes the leaves tougher. This total is split into 4 sips, each settled at the current sunlight.
After %1$s of wind-up it commits and spends PP, then absorbs for %2$s while standing still; being interrupted stops the remaining sips while the health already restored is kept.
worldcombat.skill.synthesis.timing: A self move; after %1$s s of wind-up it spends %3$s PP, recovers for %2$s s with a %4$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.synthesis.growth.0: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.synthesis.growth.1: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens further to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.synthesis.preference.a: Below this health ratio the companion schedules Synthesis; lower endures longer, higher spreads its leaves at the first wound.

Below this sunlight the companion holds the move and waits for a brighter spot; lower also heals in shade, higher only casts in strong noon light. Under half the heal threshold it ignores this and takes the floor heal to survive.
Cannot be used while at full health.
